key_insight: An LLM-guided workflow redesigned a magnesium stent across about 1,650 CAD parameters, reducing a high-percentile bend-strain objective by 32% within 15 nonlinear simulations.
engineering_relevance: Simulation-informed AI agents could enable coordinated redesign of complex components when nonlinear finite-element evaluations are expensive.
method: Use GPT-6 Astra to propose coordinated changes to the stent’s CAD parameters.
Build, mesh and evaluate each proposal with large-deformation plasticity and contact.
Feed full simulation results back to the LLM to guide subsequent designs.
evidence_signal: Within the same 15-simulation budget, Tosca improved the objective by about 10%; independent higher-fidelity evaluation of an earlier LLM design found 14% lower strain and 63% less damage at the most damaged location after full deployment.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to one component, and the independent deployment check evaluated an earlier design rather than the final 32%-improved design.
paper_title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
